summary: Possible unwanted EC2 instance(s) from OCPBUGS-62985
description: A race condition in machine creation can occasionally leave an unwanted EC2 instance in your AWS account that is not represented by a Node in your cluster. The instance may continue to incur AWS charges. Please follow the read-only diagnostic steps in the Red Hat KCS article to check for a possible extra instance. If the check identifies a possible extra instance, contact Red Hat Support and share the results before taking action.
